purpose: Machine-readable handoff/checklist for the developer. It separates implementation work from methodology decisions that must not be invented.
source_of_truth: ARUI Production Backend and Full System Developer Specification
ARUI Code Audit Developer Action List

implementation_gates.task: Keep current snapshot safe and unmerged; implement production changes in a branch/copy.
implementation_gates.done_when: Clean branch/copy exists and main is untouched until acceptance.

implementation_gates.task: Build developer-owned Node.js production API.
implementation_gates.done_when: Node API runs independently of Lovable/Supabase.

implementation_gates.task: Create PostgreSQL schema and migrations from empty DB.
implementation_gates.done_when: Empty DB migrates and seeds successfully.

implementation_gates.task: Import versioned methodology registry from source workbooks; do not manually duplicate methodology in React.
implementation_gates.done_when: Registry is source for domains, metrics, cards, questions, evidence, institutional data, anchors, scoring config, cross-domain rules and QA metadata.

implementation_gates.task: Load 11 domains, 143 metrics, 69 cards and 63 standard questions when the full methodology package is authorized.
implementation_gates.done_when: Counts are 11/143/69/63 and D01-D11 exist.

implementation_gates.task: Implement all 25 methodology profile fields.
implementation_gates.done_when: Profile captures the full 25-field register with correct four-state handling where specified.

implementation_gates.task: Implement create assessment -> screening -> responses -> institutional data -> evidence -> assessor -> maturity -> diagnostics -> score run -> report -> PDF.
implementation_gates.done_when: One clean end-to-end journey works without manual DB edits.

implementation_gates.task: Server owns screening and routing; initial screening never exceeds 30.
implementation_gates.done_when: Shown/answered/skipped/hidden execution states are stored and hidden questions are not scored.

implementation_gates.task: Render methodology-defined input types rather than generic option cards.
implementation_gates.done_when: D03 examples A05 structured+evidence, A06 frequency+evidence, A07 numeric, A08 discipline matrix+sample, A09 optional full assessment, A10 Top-3+rationale are represented correctly.

implementation_gates.task: Preserve NOT ANSWERED, NOT SURE/UNKNOWN, N/A and ANSWERED/PROVIDED as distinct states.
implementation_gates.done_when: No state silently becomes blank, zero or N/A.

implementation_gates.task: Implement server-side M/I/O scoring.
implementation_gates.done_when: With Outcome: 100*(0.45M+0.30I+0.25O)/5; legitimate Outcome N/A: 100*(0.60M+0.40I)/5; domain score is mean of applicable metric scores.

implementation_gates.task: Keep respondent answers separate from assessor M/I/O; keep evidence confidence separate from capability.
implementation_gates.done_when: Client cannot determine authoritative score.

implementation_gates.task: Implement approved N/A and missing-data behavior.
implementation_gates.done_when: Missing never silently becomes zero or N/A.

implementation_gates.task: Implement approved P0-4 context-sensitive required maturity and transformation distance.
implementation_gates.done_when: Resource envelope changes evidence burden only; no automatic capability bonus/penalty.

implementation_gates.task: Implement P0-5 contradiction/dependency diagnostics.
implementation_gates.done_when: Findings are generated but do not modify scores.

implementation_gates.task: Implement E0-E4 evidence ladder, temporal validity, corroboration/high-score controls and shared-evidence primary-owner control.
implementation_gates.done_when: Evidence is private, auditable and independently reviewable.

implementation_gates.task: Implement assessor M/I/O/N/A/rationale, evidence review, flags and adjudication/calibration records.
implementation_gates.done_when: Assessment decisions are auditable and role-controlled.

implementation_gates.task: Freeze methodology version and calculation inputs into immutable score runs.
implementation_gates.done_when: Same frozen inputs + same methodology version reproduce the same score.

implementation_gates.task: Enable D04-D11 through the same registry-driven engine, not eight hard-coded apps.
implementation_gates.done_when: Each domain is assessable through the same generic assessment, evidence, scoring and reporting engine.

implementation_gates.task: Freeze report payload and generate PDF server-side.
implementation_gates.done_when: Partial/full coverage, long names/tables and page breaks render correctly and match the approved sample structure.

implementation_gates.task: Implement authentication, RBAC, institution isolation, private evidence storage, signed access, audit logging, rate limiting, HTTPS/secrets and backup controls.
implementation_gates.done_when: Security acceptance tests pass.

implementation_gates.task: Connect React to production API and remove mock data from production path.
implementation_gates.done_when: System works with Lovable unavailable and no production scoring depends on mock fixtures.

implementation_gates.task: Add automated unit/API/E2E/security/reproducibility tests.
implementation_gates.done_when: All mandatory test categories in the verification suite pass.

implementation_gates.task: Run one clean demo institution from empty DB through PDF.
implementation_gates.done_when: No manual DB edits; every lifecycle step succeeds.

mandatory_verification_tests: Missing values do not silently become zero
Accepted N/A excluded according to approved rule
Required maturity lower and upper clamps
Cross-domain finding generated without score change
Institution A cannot access institution B
Same frozen inputs reproduce same score
methodology_pending_decisions_do_not_inv: Blank Outcome versus legitimate N/A treatment where unresolved
special_rule: D03 A09 is an optional Student Reality Sample/full-assessment workflow, not a missing normal question. Do not create a fake Q10.
143_metric_delay_rule: If the 143-metric methodology package is intentionally delayed, the developer may build the engine/schema/importer now, but must not fake, invent, duplicate or silently mark the missing D04-D11 methodology as complete. The verification suite can run with ARUI_ALLOW_PARTIAL_METHOD=1 during the interim; production V1 is not fully accepted until the authorized methodology registry is loaded.
definition_of_done: 143 metrics loaded when methodology is authorized
69 cards loaded when methodology is authorized
63 standard questions loaded when methodology is authorized
Cross-domain diagnostics work without changing scores
D04-D11 work through the same engine
Unresolved methodology decisions remain explicitly pending
No claim of empirical validation, certification or public ranking
developer_instruction: Do not report ARUI as complete because screenshots look complete. Implement, run the verification suite, provide migration/seed output, automated test results and one complete E2E run. If any methodology item is pending or provisional, preserve it as pending rather than inventing a rule.
